title: feat(wc): add <nexus-editor> Web Component wrapper (@floatboat/nexus-wc, ROADMAP #22)
body:
## Summary / 摘要

New `@floatboat/nexus-wc` package: a `<nexus-editor>` custom element that wraps `createEditor` for plain-HTML and framework-free hosts, with the same controlled-document semantics as the React/Vue bindings (ROADMAP #22).

## Motivation / 背景与动机

- Issue: —
- Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): **#22 Web Component / iframe wrapper** (`planned` → `in-progress`, this PR lands the Web Component half; iframe stays a follow-up)
- OpenSpec change: **`openspec/changes/add-wc-editor-element/`** (proposal + design + spec deltas + tasks; passes `openspec validate add-wc-editor-element --strict`)

Hosts outside React/Vue currently hand-roll the `createEditor` lifecycle glue and usually get the hard parts wrong (controlled-document feedback loops, destroy-on-move, config plumbing drift). A custom element is the standards-track answer.

This re-lands the capability attempted in **PR #49** (closed) with every review finding addressed:

| #49 finding | This PR |
|---|---|
| No OpenSpec proposal | `add-wc-editor-element` included, `--strict` valid |
| Root build filter named a non-existent package | Filter matches `@floatboat/nexus-wc` exactly; wc build ordered **after** core |
| `tsconfig` didn't extend `tsconfig.base.json` | `packages/wc/tsconfig.json` extends the base, same shape as `packages/react` |
| Missing `tsconfig.base.json` path alias | `@floatboat/nexus-wc` path + vitest alias added |
| Attribute changes after mount were silent no-ops | `value` syncs via silent `setDocument`; every other observed attribute triggers a microtask-coalesced editor rebuild that preserves document/selection/focus and re-emits `nexus-ready` — covered by tests |
| 3,175-line demo dwarfed the wrapper | No demo app; the package README carries a copy-paste plain-HTML example |

## Changes / 变更内容

- `packages/wc` (NEW): `NexusEditorElement` + side-effect-free `defineNexusEditor(tagName?)`; scalar config via observed attributes (`value`, `readonly`, `direction`, `tab-size`, `indent-guides`, `parse-delay-ms`, `slash-menu-limit`, `live-preview`, `multi-cursor`), rich config via properties (`plugins`, `parser`, `theme`, `locale`, `livePreview`, `onAssetUpload` — property wins over attribute); composed bubbling `nexus-ready` / `nexus-change` / `nexus-focus` / `nexus-blur`; deferred destroy so same-task reparenting keeps the live editor, re-insertion restores the captured document; controlled-document helpers mirrored from the React/Vue packages. 26 vitest cases.
- `openspec/`: `add-wc-editor-element` change folder (proposal, design with alternatives-considered, spec deltas, tasks).
- Root wiring: `tsconfig.base.json` path, `vitest.config.ts` alias, root `build` script (after core), `pnpm-lock.yaml` importer entry (+6 lines only).
- Docs: `packages/wc/README.md`; Web Component quick-start flavor + package-table row in `README.md` / `README.zh.md`; `wc` commit scope + bindings row in `CONTRIBUTING.md` / `CONTRIBUTING.zh.md`; ROADMAP #22 row → `in-progress` (en/zh).
- `packages/core` and all existing packages: **untouched** — the element consumes only the existing public `createEditor` / `EditorAPI` surface.

## Testing / 测试

- [x] `pnpm test` passes / 全绿 — **37 files, 541 tests** (515 existing + 26 new)
- [x] Affected packages build (`pnpm build`) / 受影响包构建通过 — plus `pnpm build:electron-demo` and `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` re-verified
- [x] New / updated vitest cases / 新增或更新的 vitest 用例: `packages/wc/test/element.test.ts` (17 — registration, lifecycle, reparent/re-insert, config precedence, controlled sync, rebuild coalescing, event delegation), `attributes.test.ts` (6), `controlled-document.test.ts` (3)
- [x] Manual UI check / 手动验证: exercised in a real Chromium via a temporary Vite page driven by Playwright — mount + live preview render, typing emits `nexus-change`, silent `value` sync does not echo, post-mount `readonly` rebuild takes effect with document preserved and `nexus-ready` re-fired, zero console errors. (electron-demo is untouched by this PR; the demo integration is deliberately a separate PR per the #49 review.)

`pnpm typecheck` also passes (strict, no emit).

## Compliance / 合规自检

- [x] **CLA signed** — will sign via the CLA bot on this PR
- [ ] **AI disclosure**: see note below.
      AI-assisted notes / AI 使用说明: Developed with AI assistance (Claude Code) driven, reviewed and directed by me end-to-end: requirement selection from the #49 review findings, API design decisions (documented with alternatives in `openspec/changes/add-wc-editor-element/design.md`), test-first workflow (all 26 tests written and observed failing before implementation), plus an independent adversarial AI review pass before submission. I can walk through and defend every line and every design decision in review.
- [x] **New dependencies**: none — `packages/wc` depends only on `@floatboat/nexus-core` (workspace)
- [x] **No build artifacts** committed
- [x] **No secrets** / `.env` / personal vault data committed

## Checklist / 自检清单

- [x] Title follows Conventional Commits
- [x] Public API changes update package README / types — `packages/wc/README.md` + root READMEs
- [x] Touched `live-preview-table.ts` → n/a (not touched)
- [x] New capability → OpenSpec proposal linked (`add-wc-editor-element`)
- [x] Change aligns with project scope (GOVERNANCE.md §4 — framework binding around `packages/core`, no product surface, no vendor SDKs)

## Screenshots / Recordings · 截图或录屏 (UI changes)

No UI changes to existing surfaces. The new element rendering (live preview, task checkboxes, blockquote) was verified in Chromium; happy to attach the recording of the smoke run if useful.

feat(wc): add <nexus-editor> custom element wrapper

New @floatboat/nexus-wc package implementing OpenSpec
add-wc-editor-element: light-DOM custom element with scalar config via
observed attributes, rich config via properties (property wins),
controlled-document value sync mirroring the React/Vue helpers,
microtask-coalesced editor rebuild for post-mount config changes
(preserves document/selection/focus, re-emits nexus-ready), deferred
destroy so same-task reparenting keeps the live editor, and composed
bubbling nexus-* events.

Workspace wiring: tsconfig.base path, vitest alias, root build script
ordered after core, lockfile importer, wc commit scope, ROADMAP #22 →
in-progress, Web Component quick-start in both READMEs.

@@ -0,0 +1,169 @@
+## Context
+
+Three existing facts shape this design:
+
+1. The React and Vue bindings already define the reference semantics
+   for wrapping `createEditor`: config is read **once** at mount
+   (neither binding reacts to prop changes after creation), except for
+   the controlled `value` / `modelValue`, which syncs external updates
+   through a silent `setDocument` guarded by a last-synced-document
+   check (`packages/react/src/use-editor.ts`,
+   `packages/vue/src/use-editor.ts`). The element must not invent a
+   third behaviour.
+2. `EditorAPI` exposes no runtime setters for `readOnly`, `tabSize`,
+   `direction`, `indentGuides`, `parseDelayMs`, `slashMenuLimit`,
+   `multiCursor` or `livePreview` — they are `createEditor`-time
+   options. Any wrapper that wants live attributes has to rebuild the
+   editor.
+3. PR #49 (closed) tried this package before. The review called out:
+   missing OpenSpec proposal; root build filter naming a package that
+   didn't exist; `tsconfig` not extending `tsconfig.base.json`;
+   missing `tsconfig.base.json` path alias; build ordered before its
+   dependency; and `attributeChangedCallback` writing private fields
+   that nothing ever re-read, so attribute changes after mount were
+   silent no-ops. Each finding maps to an explicit decision or task
+   below.
+
+## Goals / Non-Goals
+
+- **Goals**
+  - One `<nexus-editor>` tag usable from plain HTML and any framework
+    that renders DOM, with the same controlled-document semantics as
+    the React/Vue bindings.
+  - Attribute changes after mount **take effect** — either by silent
+    document sync (`value`) or by a documented, coalesced editor
+    rebuild (everything else).
+  - Survive DOM reparenting (`appendChild` to a new parent) without
+    losing the document — custom elements get disconnected/connected
+    synchronously during a move, and naive destroy-on-disconnect
+    wrappers wipe the editor.
+  - Zero new dependencies; consume only public `@floatboat/nexus-core`
+    API.
+  - Side-effect-free module (registration is an explicit call) so the
+    package can be imported in SSR code paths.
+- **Non-Goals**
+  - Shadow DOM, iframe isolation, form association, demo app — see
+    proposal "Out of scope".
+  - Fine-grained runtime reconfiguration (e.g. wiring `setTheme` for
+    the `theme` property). v1 keeps one uniform rule: config mutation
+    → rebuild. Fine-grained paths can be layered in later without
+    breaking the contract.
+
+## Decisions
+
+### Decision 1: Light DOM, element-as-container
+
+The element passes **itself** as `EditorConfig.container`, exactly
+like the React binding passes its wrapper `div`. No shadow root, no
+inner wrapper.
+
+**Alternatives considered:**
+
+- *Shadow root.* CodeMirror's style-mod can adopt styles into a
+  `ShadowRoot`, but live-preview table widgets, slash-menu coordinate
+  math (`getCoordsAtPos`), and the mermaid orphan-cleanup path have
+  never been exercised across a shadow boundary. Shipping that
+  unaudited would trade a styling nicety for correctness risk.
+  Deferred to an opt-in `shadow` attribute in a follow-up.
+- *Inner wrapper `div`.* Adds a DOM level for no benefit; the element
+  is already a block-level host the way the React/Vue wrapper `div`
+  is. Rejected.
+
+### Decision 2: Attributes for strings/booleans/numbers, properties for everything else
+
+HTML attributes can only carry strings, so the attribute surface is
+exactly the `EditorConfig` subset with scalar types: `value`,
+`readonly`, `direction`, `tab-size`, `indent-guides`,
+`parse-delay-ms`, `slash-menu-limit`, `live-preview`, `multi-cursor`.
+Rich config (`plugins`, `parser`, `theme`, `locale`, `livePreview`
+object form, `onAssetUpload`) is property-only — the standard custom
+element pattern ("attributes for data, properties for objects").
+
+When both are set, the **property wins** — a property is an explicit
+imperative act by the host, an attribute is declarative markup.
+JSON-in-attribute (e.g. `theme='{"bg":...}'`) was rejected: it can't
+express functions (`parser`, `onAssetUpload`, plugin hooks), silently
+diverges from the typed API, and encourages copy-paste config drift.
+
+### Decision 3: `value` syncs silently; every other config change rebuilds
+
+`value` attribute/property updates reuse the controlled-document
+helpers (`shouldSyncControlledDocument` etc., mirrored from the
+React/Vue packages) and apply via `setDocument(next, { silent: true })`
+— identical to the React `value` prop contract, including not echoing
+a `nexus-change` for content the host just pushed in.
+
+All other observed attributes (and rich properties) mark the config
+dirty and schedule a **microtask-coalesced rebuild**: capture the
+current document and selection, `destroy()`, `createEditor` with the
+new config snapshot, restore document and selection (clamped by core),
+re-emit `nexus-ready` with the fresh `EditorAPI`.
+
+**Alternatives considered:**
+
+- *Ignore post-mount changes (React/Vue behaviour).* Defensible for
+  framework bindings where the component contract documents it, but
+  it is exactly the behaviour that closed PR #49 — in markup-driven
+  hosts, `el.setAttribute("readonly", "")` silently doing nothing
+  reads as a bug, not a contract. Rejected.
+- *Per-option live wiring.* Requires core-side runtime setters that
+  don't exist (`EditorAPI` has `setTheme` only); building eight
+  bespoke code paths in the wrapper would fork behaviour from
+  `createEditor`'s option handling. Rejected for v1.
+- *Rebuild synchronously per attribute.* Frameworks patch attributes
+  one at a time; three attribute writes would create and destroy three
+  editors. The microtask coalescer collapses them into one rebuild.
+
+`nexus-ready` intentionally fires again after each rebuild: the old
+`EditorAPI` is destroyed and any host reference to it is stale, so the
+event doubles as the invalidation signal. This is documented in the
+README and spec.
+
+### Decision 4: Deferred destroy on disconnect
+
+`disconnectedCallback` does not destroy immediately — it queues a
+microtask and only destroys if the element is still disconnected when
+the microtask runs. Moving an element (`newParent.appendChild(el)`)
+fires disconnected + connected synchronously in the same task, so a
+move keeps the live editor (CodeMirror's DOM travels inside the
+element). A real removal destroys the editor and captures the final
+document, so a later re-insertion recreates the editor with the text
+intact.
+
+**Alternative considered:** destroy eagerly and always recreate on
+connect. Simpler, but reparenting then resets scroll/undo/IME state —
+and layout-driven reparenting is common in exactly the
+non-React/Vue hosts this package targets. Rejected.
+
+### Decision 5: Explicit registration, no import side effects
+
+`defineNexusEditor(tagName = "nexus-editor")` registers the element
+and is idempotent for the default flow (re-invoking with a tag that is
+already defined as `NexusEditorElement` is a no-op; a tag claimed by a
+*different* constructor throws — silently swallowing that collision
+would leave `<nexus-editor>` rendering someone else's widget).
+Importing the module never touches `customElements`, so the package is
+safe to import in SSR / Node contexts where `customElements` does not
+exist.
+
+## Risks / Trade-offs
+
+- **Rebuild discards undo history.** Documented. Acceptable: config
+  flips are rare host actions (e.g. toggling `readonly` on save), and
+  the React/Vue bindings offer no better today (they ignore the change
+  entirely).
+- **`nexus-ready` fires more than once.** Hosts that cache the
+  `EditorAPI` must rebind on each `nexus-ready`. Called out in the
+  README with a delegation example.
+- **IME composition vs. controlled sync.** Core defers `setDocument`
+  during composition and applies the last pending load at
+  `compositionend`, so a controlled push landing mid-composition is not
+  lost in normal operation. The one lossy window is a config rebuild
+  during active composition (the destroyed editor drops its pending
+  load); the rebuild resets the last-synced guard to the captured
+  document, so the host's next push applies cleanly. Both behaviours
+  are pinned by regression tests.
+- **jsdom coverage limits.** vitest+jsdom exercises registration,
+  lifecycle, attribute plumbing, controlled sync, and event dispatch,
+  but not real layout/IME. Same limitation the React/Vue test suites
+  accept; manual verification in a browser is recorded in the PR.

@@ -0,0 +1,117 @@
+# Change: Add `@floatboat/nexus-wc` — `<nexus-editor>` Web Component wrapper
+
+## Why
+
+ROADMAP #22 ("Web Component / iframe wrapper", P2) exists because the
+current SDK story stops at React and Vue. Hosts outside those two
+ecosystems — Svelte / SolidJS apps, server-rendered Rails or Django
+templates, legacy jQuery surfaces, CMS plugin sandboxes — today have to
+hand-roll the same ~80 lines of `createEditor` lifecycle glue that
+`packages/react/src/use-editor.ts` and `packages/vue/src/use-editor.ts`
+already encode, and they usually get the hard parts wrong:
+
+- **Controlled-document feedback loops.** Wiring `value` in and
+  `change` out without a silent-sync guard echoes every keystroke back
+  into `setDocument`, which resets the viewport and breaks IME
+  composition (see `SetDocumentOptions.silent` in
+  `packages/core/src/types.ts`).
+- **Lifecycle leaks.** Forgetting `editor.destroy()` on teardown leaks
+  CodeMirror view listeners; destroying eagerly on every DOM move
+  loses the document.
+- **Config plumbing drift.** Each hand-rolled wrapper picks a different
+  subset of `EditorConfig` to expose, so knowledge doesn't transfer
+  between hosts.
+
+A custom element is the standards-track answer: one `<nexus-editor>`
+tag that works in plain HTML and in every framework that can render
+DOM, with the same controlled-document semantics the React and Vue
+bindings already ship.
+
+An earlier community attempt (PR #49) was closed with concrete review
+findings: no OpenSpec proposal, four workspace-wiring bugs (package
+name mismatch in root build filters, `tsconfig` not extending the
+base, missing `tsconfig.base.json` path alias, build ordered before
+its dependency), attribute changes after mount silently doing nothing,
+and a 3,175-line demo app dwarfing the wrapper. This change re-lands
+the capability with those findings addressed and the demo explicitly
+out of scope.
+
+## What Changes
+
+- **New package `@floatboat/nexus-wc`** under `packages/wc/`. Public
+  surface:
+  - `NexusEditorElement` — the custom element class. Mounts a core
+    editor into itself (light DOM) on `connectedCallback`, destroys it
+    when the element actually leaves the document, and preserves the
+    document across same-task DOM moves and detach/reattach cycles.
+  - `defineNexusEditor(tagName = "nexus-editor")` — idempotent
+    registration helper. Importing the package has no side effects
+    (SSR-safe); registration is an explicit call.
+  - Event detail types: `NexusChangeDetail`, `NexusReadyDetail`.
+- **Attributes** (declarative, all observed): `value`, `readonly`,
+  `direction`, `tab-size`, `indent-guides`, `parse-delay-ms`,
+  `slash-menu-limit`, `live-preview`, `multi-cursor`. Boolean
+  attributes follow the HTML convention — presence means `true`,
+  absence defers to the core default.
+- **Properties** (imperative, for non-string config): `plugins`,
+  `parser`, `theme`, `locale`, `livePreview` (object form),
+  `onAssetUpload`, plus a `value` accessor pair and a read-only
+  `editor` escape hatch returning the live `EditorAPI`.
+- **Attribute changes after mount take effect** — the finding that
+  closed PR #49. `value` syncs through the same silent-`setDocument`
+  controlled-document helpers the React and Vue bindings use; every
+  other observed attribute schedules a microtask-coalesced editor
+  rebuild that preserves the current document and selection, then
+  re-emits `nexus-ready` with the new `EditorAPI` instance.
+- **Events**: `nexus-ready`, `nexus-change`, `nexus-focus`,
+  `nexus-blur` — `CustomEvent`s that bubble and are `composed`, so
+  hosts can delegate at any ancestor.
+- **Workspace integration** — `tsconfig.base.json` path alias,
+  `vitest.config.ts` resolve alias, root `package.json` `build` script
+  entry ordered **after** `@floatboat/nexus-core`, scope whitelist row
+  in `CONTRIBUTING.md` / `CONTRIBUTING.zh.md` (`wc`), ROADMAP #22 row
+  update, Web Component section in `README.md` / `README.zh.md`.
+
+No breaking changes. No core changes — the element consumes only the
+existing public `createEditor` / `EditorAPI` surface, exactly like the
+React and Vue bindings.
+
+## Impact
+
+- Affected specs:
+  - `wc-editor-element` (NEW capability) — element lifecycle,
+    attribute/property config contract, controlled document semantics,
+    event surface.
+- Affected code:
+  - `packages/wc/` (NEW package — `src/index.ts`, `src/element.ts`,
+    `src/attributes.ts`, `src/controlled-document.ts`, `README.md`,
+    `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `test/element.test.ts`,
+    `test/attributes.test.ts`, `test/controlled-document.test.ts`).
+  - `tsconfig.base.json` (path alias).
+  - `vitest.config.ts` (resolve alias).
+  - `package.json` (root `build` script — after core).
+  - `pnpm-lock.yaml` (workspace package registration).
+  - `pnpm-workspace.yaml` left untouched — already globs `packages/*`.
+  - `CONTRIBUTING.md` / `CONTRIBUTING.zh.md` (scope whitelist row).
+  - `docs/ROADMAP.md` / `docs/ROADMAP.zh.md` (row #22 status + link).
+  - `README.md` / `README.zh.md` (Web Component quick-start flavor).
+- New external dependencies: **none**. The package depends only on
+  `@floatboat/nexus-core` (workspace) and the DOM standard library.
+- Out of scope (explicit non-goals):
+  - **Shadow DOM.** CodeMirror's style-mod can adopt into shadow
+    roots, but the live-preview overlays, slash-menu coordinate math,
+    and table-widget interactions have never been audited against a
+    shadow boundary. Light DOM matches what the React/Vue bindings
+    render today; an opt-in `shadow` attribute is a follow-up change.
+  - **iframe wrapper.** The other half of ROADMAP #22 — different
+    isolation model, different messaging surface, separate proposal.
+  - **Form association** (`ElementInternals`, `formAssociated`).
+    Useful for `<form>` submission of markdown, but jsdom support is
+    incomplete and it drags in validation semantics; follow-up.
+  - **A demo app.** Per the PR #49 review, a demo belongs in its own
+    PR. The package README carries a copy-paste plain-HTML example.
+  - **Runtime reactivity for rich properties** (`plugins`, `parser`,
+    `theme`, `locale`). Setting them after mount triggers the same
+    documented rebuild as attributes; fine-grained hot swapping
+    (e.g. `setTheme`) is deliberately not wired in v1 to keep the
+    rebuild semantics uniform.

+# WC Editor Element Spec — `<nexus-editor>` custom element
+
+## ADDED Requirements
+
+### Requirement: Explicit, Side-Effect-Free Registration
+
+The package SHALL export `defineNexusEditor(tagName?: string): void`
+and the `NexusEditorElement` class. Importing the package SHALL NOT
+register anything with `customElements`. `defineNexusEditor` SHALL
+default the tag name to `"nexus-editor"`, SHALL be a no-op when the
+tag is already registered as `NexusEditorElement`, and SHALL throw
+when the tag is registered to a different constructor.
+
+#### Scenario: Import has no side effects
+- **WHEN** the module is imported and `defineNexusEditor` is never
+  called
+- **THEN** `customElements.get("nexus-editor")` SHALL be `undefined`
+
+#### Scenario: Double registration is a no-op
+- **WHEN** `defineNexusEditor()` is invoked twice
+- **THEN** the second call SHALL NOT throw
+
+#### Scenario: Foreign constructor collision throws
+- **WHEN** `"nexus-editor"` is already defined as another element
+  class and `defineNexusEditor()` is invoked
+- **THEN** the call SHALL throw
+
+### Requirement: Editor Lifecycle Bound to Document Connection
+
+A connected `<nexus-editor>` SHALL create one core editor via
+`createEditor` with the element itself as `container`, and SHALL emit
+`nexus-ready` (detail: `{ editor: EditorAPI }`). Removing the element
+from the document SHALL destroy the editor. Moving the element within
+the document in a single task (reparenting) SHALL NOT destroy the
+editor. Re-inserting a previously removed element SHALL create a fresh
+editor seeded with the document text captured at destroy time.
+
+#### Scenario: Connection mounts an editor
+- **WHEN** a `<nexus-editor value="# Hi">` element is appended to the
+  document
+- **THEN** the element SHALL contain a `.cm-editor` DOM subtree
+- **AND** `nexus-ready` SHALL have fired with a usable `EditorAPI`
+
+#### Scenario: Removal destroys the editor
+- **WHEN** a connected element is removed and pending microtasks flush
+- **THEN** `element.editor` SHALL be `null`
+- **AND** the `.cm-editor` subtree SHALL be gone
+
+#### Scenario: Reparenting preserves the editor
+- **WHEN** a connected element is moved to another parent via
+  `appendChild` in the same task
+- **THEN** the same `EditorAPI` instance SHALL remain live and its
+  document SHALL be unchanged
+
+#### Scenario: Re-insertion restores the document
+- **WHEN** an element whose document was `"draft"` is removed,
+  microtasks flush, and the element is appended again
+- **THEN** a new editor SHALL exist whose document is `"draft"`
+
+### Requirement: Scalar Config via Attributes, Rich Config via Properties
+
+The element SHALL read `value`, `readonly`, `direction`, `tab-size`,
+`indent-guides`, `parse-delay-ms`, `slash-menu-limit`, `live-preview`
+and `multi-cursor` attributes into the corresponding `EditorConfig`
+fields at creation time. Boolean attributes SHALL follow the HTML
+presence convention. The element SHALL expose `plugins`, `parser`,
+`theme`, `locale`, `livePreview` and `onAssetUpload` as JavaScript
+properties. When a property and an attribute both configure the same
+option, the property SHALL win.
+
+#### Scenario: Attributes reach the editor
+- **WHEN** `<nexus-editor value="# Hi" readonly tab-size="2">` is
+  connected
+- **THEN** the mounted editor's document SHALL be `"# Hi"`
+- **AND** the editor SHALL reject user edits (readOnly)
+
+#### Scenario: Plugins arrive as a property
+- **WHEN** `element.plugins = [somePlugin]` is set before connection
+- **THEN** the mounted editor SHALL expose that plugin's slash
+  commands via `getSlashCommands()`
+
+#### Scenario: Property overrides attribute
+- **WHEN** `live-preview` attribute is present and
+  `element.livePreview = false` was set
+- **THEN** the editor SHALL be created with live preview disabled
+
+### Requirement: Controlled Document Semantics for `value`
+
+The `value` property getter SHALL return the current editor document.
+Setting the `value` property or attribute on a mounted element SHALL
+apply the new text via silent `setDocument` when it differs from the
+last synced document, and SHALL NOT emit `nexus-change` for that
+update. User edits SHALL emit `nexus-change` (detail:
+`{ markdown: string; ast: Root }`) and update the value returned by
+the getter without reflecting to the attribute.
+
+#### Scenario: External value update is silent
+- **WHEN** a mounted element's `value` property is set to new text
+- **THEN** `element.editor.getDocument()` SHALL return the new text
+- **AND** no `nexus-change` event SHALL fire for that update
+
+#### Scenario: User edits emit change
+- **WHEN** the document changes through the editor (non-silent)
+- **THEN** a `nexus-change` event SHALL fire whose
+  `detail.markdown` equals the new document
+
+#### Scenario: Value attribute does not echo
+- **WHEN** the `value` attribute is set to the text the editor already
+  contains
+- **THEN** no `setDocument` round-trip SHALL occur
+
+### Requirement: Post-Mount Config Changes Rebuild the Editor
+
+The element SHALL apply post-mount changes to every observed attribute
+other than `value` by rebuilding the editor with the updated config in
+a microtask. Multiple changes in one task SHALL coalesce into a single
+rebuild. The rebuild SHALL preserve the current document and selection,
+and SHALL emit `nexus-ready` again with the new `EditorAPI` instance.
+
+#### Scenario: readonly becomes effective after mount
+- **WHEN** `setAttribute("readonly", "")` is called on a mounted
+  editable element and microtasks flush
+- **THEN** the rebuilt editor SHALL reject user edits
+- **AND** its document SHALL equal the pre-rebuild document
+
+#### Scenario: Multiple attribute writes coalesce
+- **WHEN** `tab-size`, `direction` and `indent-guides` are all set in
+  the same task
+- **THEN** exactly one additional `nexus-ready` SHALL fire
+
+### Requirement: Composed Custom Events
+
+`nexus-ready`, `nexus-change`, `nexus-focus` and `nexus-blur` SHALL be
+dispatched as `CustomEvent`s with `bubbles: true` and
+`composed: true`.
+
+#### Scenario: Events are delegable
+- **WHEN** a `nexus-change` listener is attached to an ancestor of the
+  element and the document changes
+- **THEN** the listener SHALL receive the event

+# @floatboat/nexus-wc
+
+Web Component wrapper for [Nexus-Editor](https://github.com/floatboatai/Nexus-Editor): one `<nexus-editor>` tag for plain HTML and for every framework that renders DOM.
+
+## Install
+
+```bash
+pnpm add @floatboat/nexus-wc @floatboat/nexus-core @floatboat/nexus-preset-gfm
+```
+
+## Quick start
+
+Registration is an explicit call — importing the package has no side effects, so it is safe in SSR code paths.
+
+```html
+<script type="module">
+  import { defineNexusEditor } from "@floatboat/nexus-wc";
+
+  defineNexusEditor(); // registers <nexus-editor>
+</script>
+
+<nexus-editor value="# Hello" live-preview tab-size="2"></nexus-editor>
+```
+
+The element mounts a CodeMirror instance into itself (light DOM) when it is connected, and destroys it when the element leaves the document. Reparenting the element (`appendChild` to a new parent) keeps the live editor; removing and re-inserting it recreates the editor with the last document text intact.
+
+## Attributes
+
+Scalar config only — HTML attributes carry strings. Boolean attributes follow the HTML convention: present means `true`, absent defers to the core default.
+
+| Attribute | Type | Maps to `EditorConfig` |
+|---|---|---|
+| `value` | string | `initialValue` + controlled document (see below) |
+| `readonly` | boolean | `readOnly` |
+| `direction` | `"ltr"` \| `"rtl"` | `direction` |
+| `tab-size` | integer | `tabSize` |
+| `indent-guides` | boolean | `indentGuides` |
+| `parse-delay-ms` | integer | `parseDelayMs` |
+| `slash-menu-limit` | integer | `slashMenuLimit` |
+| `live-preview` | boolean | `livePreview` |
+| `multi-cursor` | boolean | `multiCursor` |
+
+Malformed numbers (`tab-size="abc"`) are ignored so core defaults stay in charge — `NaN` never reaches `createEditor`.
+
+## Properties
+
+Rich config that attributes cannot express. An explicitly set property overrides the matching attribute.
+
+| Property | Type |
+|---|---|
+| `value` | `string` — read/write, see controlled usage |
+| `editor` | `EditorAPI \| null` — read-only escape hatch |
+| `plugins` | `NexusPlugin[]` |
+| `parser` | `ParserLike` |
+| `theme` | `NexusTheme` |
+| `locale` | `Partial<NexusLocale>` |
+| `livePreview` | `boolean \| LivePreviewConfig` |
+| `onAssetUpload` | `(file: File) => Promise<string \| null>` |
+
+```js
+const el = document.querySelector("nexus-editor");
+el.plugins = [createGfmPreset()];
+```
+
+## Events
+
+All events are `CustomEvent`s with `bubbles: true` and `composed: true`, so they can be handled by delegation at any ancestor.
+
+| Event | `detail` |
+|---|---|
+| `nexus-ready` | `{ editor: EditorAPI }` |
+| `nexus-change` | `{ markdown: string, ast: Root }` |
+| `nexus-focus` | — |
+| `nexus-blur` | — |
+
+`nexus-ready` fires on every editor (re)creation — after the initial mount **and** after a config rebuild (below). Hosts that cache the `EditorAPI` must rebind on each `nexus-ready`; the previous instance is destroyed.
+
+Lifecycle events dispatch synchronously, so an element already in the markup emits its first `nexus-ready` during the `defineNexusEditor()` call. Attach listeners before registering (or before appending the element) — or skip the race entirely by reading `el.editor`, which is non-null once mounted:
+
+```js
+const el = document.querySelector("nexus-editor");
+el.addEventListener("nexus-ready", (event) => {
+  api = event.detail.editor; // rebinds after every rebuild
+});
+defineNexusEditor();
+```
+
+## Controlled usage
+
+Set the `value` property (or attribute) when the host owns the markdown string. External updates are applied with a silent `setDocument` — the editor does not echo a `nexus-change` for content the host just pushed in, so the usual controlled-input feedback loop cannot form. This is the same contract as the React `value` prop and the Vue `v-model`.
+
+```js
+el.addEventListener("nexus-change", (event) => {
+  store.markdown = event.detail.markdown;
+});
+store.subscribe((markdown) => {
+  el.value = markdown; // silent, no echo
+});
+```
+
+## Config changes after mount
+
+`createEditor` options have no runtime setters, so changing any config attribute (or rich property) on a mounted element rebuilds the editor: the current document and selection are preserved, focus is restored, and `nexus-ready` fires again with the fresh `EditorAPI`. Multiple writes in the same task coalesce into a single rebuild.
+
+Undo history does not survive a rebuild — treat config flips as host-level actions (e.g. toggling `readonly` around a save), not per-keystroke state.
+
+## Styling
+
+The element renders in light DOM and defaults itself to `display: block` (only when no inline display is set). Style it like any block element:
+
+```css
+nexus-editor {
+  min-height: 320px;
+  border: 1px solid #ddd;
+}
+```
